verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents that a custom environment version can describe MCP servers, so MCP servers can be configured into the product's simulated worlds. That is a thin, single mention, and it is unclear whether Chronicle's own features consume those tools or whether they are only exposed to the agent under test. missing for 10: documentation of how MCP servers are connected and configured, confirmation that the product itself calls MCP tools, supported transports and auth, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: A custom version can describe recorded HTTP replays, seeded datastores, MCP servers, or standalone twins.
